# Provenance Model

This document maps W3C PROV-O (PROV Ontology) concepts to Semantic MediaWiki properties, enabling standardized provenance tracking.

== W3C PROV-O Mapping ==

=== Core Properties ===

| PROV-O Term | SMW Property | Type | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| prov:wasGeneratedBy | [Property:Was generated by](Property:Was generated by)(Property:Was generated by.md) | Page | The process or activity that generated the entity |
| prov:wasAttributedTo | [Property:Was attributed to](Property:Was attributed to)(Property:Was attributed to.md) | Page | The agent responsible for the entity |
| prov:wasDerivedFrom | [Property:Was derived from](Property:Was derived from)(Property:Was derived from.md) | Page | The source entity from which this was derived |
| prov:wasInfluencedBy | [Property:Was influenced by](Property:Was influenced by)(Property:Was influenced by.md) | Page | An entity that influenced this entity |
| prov:generatedAtTime | [Property:Was generated at time](Property:Was generated at time)(Property:Was generated at time.md) | Date | When the entity was created |
| prov:startedAtTime | [Property:Was started at time](Property:Was started at time)(Property:Was started at time.md) | Date | When an activity began |
| prov:endedAtTime | [Property:Was ended at time](Property:Was ended at time)(Property:Was ended at time.md) | Date | When an activity ended |
| prov:used | [Property:Used](Property:Used)(Property:Used.md) | Page | An entity used by an activity |
| prov:wasAssociatedWith | [Property:Was associated with](Property:Was associated with)(Property:Was associated with.md) | Page | An agent associated with an activity |
| prov:actedOnBehalfOf | [Property:Acted on behalf of](Property:Acted on behalf of)(Property:Acted on behalf of.md) | Page | An agent acting on behalf of another |

=== SMW Property Definitions ===

==== Was Generated By ====
```

This property associates an entity with the activity that generated it.

[Has type::Page](Has type::Page)(Has type::Page.md)
[Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasGeneratedBy](Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasGeneratedBy)(Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasGeneratedBy.md)

```

==== Was Attributed To ====
```

This property attributes an entity to an agent.

[Has type::Page](Has type::Page)(Has type::Page.md)
[Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasAttributedTo](Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasAttributedTo)(Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasAttributedTo.md)

```

==== Was Derived From ====
```

This property indicates derivation from a source entity.

[Has type::Page](Has type::Page)(Has type::Page.md)
[Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom](Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom)(Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom.md)

```

==== Was Generated At Time ====
```

This property records the generation timestamp.

[Has type::Date](Has type::Date)(Has type::Date.md)
[Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#generatedAtTime](Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#generatedAtTime)(Equivalent URI::http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#generatedAtTime.md)

```

== Usage Patterns ==

=== Pattern 1: Document Attribution ===
```

{{#set:
 |Was generated by=Process:DocumentImport
 |Was attributed to=Agent:ResearchTeam_Alpha
 |Was generated at time=2026-02-12T20:00:00
}}

```

=== Pattern 2: Derived Knowledge ===
```

{{#set:
 |Was derived from=Source:Primary_Dataset_2026
 |Was influenced by=Source:Secondary_Analysis
 |Was generated by=Process:KnowledgeExtraction
}}

```

=== Pattern 3: Activity Recording ===
```

{{#set:
 |Was started at time=2026-02-12T08:00:00
 |Was ended at time=2026-02-12T16:00:00
 |Was associated with=Agent:DataScientist
 |Used=Resource:ComputingCluster
}}

```

== Provenance Query Examples ==

```

```

```

```

=== Temporal Provenance ===
```

```

== Integration with EPV Framework ==

The Provenance Model integrates with the EPV Framework as follows:
* '''Events''': Was generated at time, Was started at time, Was ended at time
* '''Propositions''': Was attributed to, Was derived from, Was associated with
* '''Values''': Temporal values (dates) as measurement events
